title: Iran Signals Readiness to Escalate War With U.S. Amid Rising Economic Pressure
summary: The Iranian government is taking an increasingly aggressive approach as it confronts a growing economic threat and worries that its grip on the Strait of Hormuz is slipping, analysts say.
